aesthetics.typography: Open Sans throughout (sidebar nav, source titles, meta links); Arial in search input
aesthetics.typeScale: flat scale: 16px regular source titles, 13px light-grey meta/action links, 11px Export/import links, 13px uppercase small-caps-like sidebar section headings; little weight contrast

notes: selfoss manage-sources page. Main area has subtle diagonal pinstripe texture; each source row is a faint white band ~40px tall with colored 2-letter favicon squares. Actions are inline text links separated by bullets (Edit • More actions • Last post seen X). First row (Tin Can Podcast, no favicon/last-seen) has a red 1px outline — likely an error/never-fetched state. Sidebar has a teal-grey vertical rule on its right edge; bottom has two square dark icon buttons (refresh, cloud/settings). Search is a toggle icon that expands a search box over the sidebar edge.
